description: This file defines the interface for the jsonhal_lib_wrp module, including function declarations for initializing, getting, and setting JSON parameters, as well as creating JSON request messages. It also includes relevant headers and macro definitions, serving as a header interface for the JSON HAL wrapper library.

methods.name: jsonhal_init
methods.description: Initializes the JSON HAL with a specified configuration file.

methods.name: jsonhal_getparam
methods.description: Retrieves the value of a parameter given its name.

methods.name: jsonhal_setparam
methods.description: Sets the value of a parameter given its name, type, and value.

methods.name: create_json_request_message
methods.description: Creates a JSON object representing a request message with specified action type and parameters.
